title: Gallery app metadata
description: Optional per-app override written to apps/<slug>/meta.json. Every field is optional — anything absent is derived from the built HTML (title, description) or from git/mtime (created). A folder with no meta.json is fully valid.

slug.description: If present, must equal the folder name (enforced by validate.mjs).

description_en.description: English summary shown alongside the French description (bilingual gallery policy).
